messages:
maria: Creating RC v3.2.0-rc1 for runtime + API batching changes. Pinning artifact sha256: abcd1234ef56deadbeef7890cafe1234567890abcd. Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: KV warm -> canary 5% (15m) -> 20% (30m) -> 100% (gradual). Rollback: revert to v3.1.4, feature-flag `batching_v2` off. Release notes: https://go/release-notes/v3.2.0-rc1. Looking for quick signoff and ops ack.
deploy-bot: rc created: rc-v3.2.0-rc1 (artifact abcd1234...), scheduled promo window 2026-03-22T02:00Z. Use `/deploy promote rc-v3.2.0-rc1 --pin=abcd1234ef56` to promote manually. Dry-run artifacts validated.
ian: Any DB migrations or config flips? I can't be on for the whole window.
maria: No DB schema changes. Only runtime KV cache warming and batching config. Will add the migration tag to the release notes (none).
chris: LGTM. I'll own telemetry and latency dashboard during rollout. Plan sounds good — 15m soak at 5% then 20% for 30m.
sara: Reviewed release notes, added section about batching heuristics and cost/regression checklist. Docs link updated.
alex: Pin approved. Pin recorded: abcd1234ef56. Prepared rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to previous pinned artifact
/deploy promote v3.1.4 --pin=beef9876feed --reason="rollback v3.2.0-rc1"
# feature flag off
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://flags.api/flags/batching_v2/off
```
deploy-bot: scheduled kv-warm job at 2026-03-22T01:50Z (10m before window). Dry-run kv warm succeeded in staging.
oncall-sheriff: ack. I'll be primary onpager for the window and will watch `#telemetry` and `#incidents` channels.
maria: Starting KV warm now (triggered). Will post updates at each step. @chris @oncall-sheriff
deploy-bot: KV warm complete (warm keys: 94%). No cold starts reported in canary baseline.
deploy-bot: canary shift initiated: 5% traffic -> rc-v3.2.0-rc1
chris: Observing canary: latency stable, 95th p95 unchanged, error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%). Good so far.
alex: smoke tests OK. Token cost per request within expected variance.
deploy-bot: canary auto-escalation to 20% scheduled in 15m unless aborted.
ian: leaving an operational note: if we see memory pressure >85% on the runtime pool at 20% scale, rollback immediately. I added that to the rollback checklist.
deploy-bot: canary escalation executed: 20% traffic -> rc-v3.2.0-rc1
chris: 20% hold: telemetry looks clean. No new errors in traces or SLO regressions.
alex: running post-canary QA checks: end-to-end smoke + downstream ingestion checks OK.
oncall-sheriff: No alerts in the last 25m. Standing by for full promotion.
maria: Promoting to 100% now. /deploy promote rc-v3.2.0-rc1 --pin=abcd1234ef56 (executing)
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Traffic at 100% on rc-v3.2.0-rc1. Old version v3.1.4 kept pinned for 30m rollback window.
oncall-sheriff: Acknowledged. 30m rollback window active.
chris: Watching cost and latency dashboards. So far stable. Will escalate if anything pops.
maria: Thanks everyone — great coordination. I'll file the GA checklist and close this RC thread after the rollback window expires. Follow-up: I'll post the final release notes and the changelog commit link."
